extDescription: Sync your bookmarks between browsers using a GitHub Gist.

popup.willCreateGist: A new gist will be created on the first sync.
popup.missingToken: Missing token: open the panel to set it.

main.tokenHelp: Needs the gist scope. Stored only in this browser (storage.local), never in the cloud.
main.gistPlaceholder: leave empty to create a new one
main.gistHelp: The identifier at the end of the gist URL (gist.github.com/user/this-part). Empty = a new gist is created on the first sync.
main.modeFull: Full — download, merge, apply and upload
main.modePull: Download — only apply the gist in this browser
main.modePush: Upload — only publish the local state

settings.rootsHelp: Only roots available in $1 are listed. Other roots present in the gist are preserved untouched.
settings.languageHelp: By default the browser language is used ($1).
settings.languageNote: The extension name and description shown by the browser always follow the browser language.
settings.dryRunHelp: Computes and logs what it would do, but changes neither bookmarks nor the gist.
settings.credentialsHelp: Deletes the token and gist id stored in this browser. The gist on GitHub is not touched.

about.step1: Bookmarks are read from this browser and normalized.
about.step2: The gist JSON is downloaded and merged by URL, keeping the folder path.
about.step3: The result is applied in the browser (create, rename, delete) inside the managed roots.
about.step4: The merged document is published back to the gist.
about.union: Merging is a union: a bookmark present on only one side is never deleted. Propagating deletions needs a last-write-wins mode that will come later.

status.connectedNoScope: Connected as $1, but the token lacks the "gist" scope

sync.gistChanged: The gist changed since the last sync; it will be merged anyway.
sync.gistMissing: The configured gist does not exist; a new one will be created.
sync.skippedRoots: Roots not available in this browser: $1
sync.dryRun: Dry run: nothing was written to the browser or to the gist.
sync.pullOnly: Download mode: nothing was published to the gist.

gist.invalidFile: The gist file $1 does not contain valid JSON
gist.forbidden: The token lacks permission (needs the "gist" scope)
